description: Read one web page as clean Markdown (or plain text) for an LLM: the main content without menus, cookie banners and footers, plus title, description, author, published date, language and canonical URL; links on request. robots.txt is respected (a disallowed page is refused and not charged). No JavaScript is run. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

images.description: 1 = keep images with alt text as Markdown images

links.description: 1 = also return the page's links (up to 300)

maxChars.description: Cut the content at this many characters, 500-200000, default 30000

name: read
title: Read
